description: IGI Life Insurance Limited is a Pakistani life insurer and family takaful operator, writing life insurance, accident and health cover, retirement planning and Shariah-compliant family takaful. It distributes through individual life, bancassurance, micro insurance and corporate channels, and runs the IGI Life Vitality wellness programme alongside its protection and savings products.
headOffice: 7th Floor, The Forum, Suite 701-713, G-20, Khayaban-e-Jami, Block 9, Clifton, Karachi 75600, Pakistan
